one_line: Early Kerala astronomer Haridatta and later astrologer-astronomer Govinda Bhattathiri from the Nila valley tradition.

appearance.age_look: Haridatta appears as a lean man in his late 30s; Govinda Bhattathiri as a slightly broader-shouldered man in his early 40s.
appearance.face: Haridatta has an oval face, medium-brown Kerala complexion, sharp nose and focused, thoughtful eyes with a calm half-smile; Govinda has a slightly squarer jaw, similar complexion, thicker brows, and a quietly intense, analytical gaze, usually with a composed, serious expression.
appearance.hair: Haridatta’s hair is black, pulled back into a neat topknot with a thin center-parted fringe and a simple off-white cloth band tied around the knot; Govinda’s hair is also black, combed back smoothly into a higher, slightly fuller topknot wrapped with a narrow reddish-brown headcloth strip, both with short, tidy side hair and no facial hair.
appearance.costume: Both wear modest, era-appropriate Kerala brahmin scholar dress: Haridatta has a cream-colored cotton dhoti tied slightly above the ankles with a narrow maroon border, a light off-white upper cloth (veshti style) draped over both shoulders and across the chest, and a simple thin wooden-bead necklace; Govinda wears a slightly richer handloom dhoti in pale sand-beige with a dark green border, and a soft, muted-ochre angavastra shawl draped from the left shoulder across his torso and over the right forearm, with a small waist knot securing the dhoti and a slightly thicker rudraksha-style bead necklace; both are barefoot, with era-accurate simplicity, no modern fastenings, and minimal brass bangles on their wrists.
appearance.signature: A single palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with coir string: Haridatta holds a slightly older-looking bundle marked by a reddish-brown wooden stylus tucked into the string, while Govinda carries a neater bundle with a dark wooden stylus and a small knotted cord loop for hanging at his side.

ref_desc: Haridatta and Govinda Bhattathiri are two medium-brown Kerala scholars with black topknots, cream and sand-beige dhotis, off-white and ochre shawls, bead necklaces, barefoot, each holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with wooden stylus in maroon and dark green accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two Kerala brahmin scholars from the Nila valley: Haridatta, lean and in his late 30s, medium-brown complexion, oval face with sharp nose and focused eyes, black hair in a neat topknot banded with a simple off-white cloth, wearing a cream cotton dhoti with narrow maroon border tied above his ankles, a light off-white upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across his chest, a thin wooden-bead necklace, and barefoot, holding an older palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with coir string and a reddish-brown wooden stylus tucked into the knot; and Govinda Bhattathiri, slightly broader in his early 40s, similar complexion with a squarer jaw and thicker brows, black hair in a higher, fuller topknot wrapped with a narrow reddish-brown headcloth strip, dressed in a sand-beige handloom dhoti with dark green border and a muted-ochre angavastra shawl draped from his left shoulder across his torso and over his right forearm, a slightly thicker bead necklace, minimal brass bangles, barefoot, carrying a neater palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a dark wooden stylus and a small knotted cord loop at his side; use a restrained palette of cream, sand beige, maroon, muted ochre, and dark green, with clear, clean lines so both characters can be consistently redrawn from head, face, hair and garments down to their palm-leaf manuscript prop.
